title: Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 contains an integer overflow in jbigtopnm that…
description: An integer overflow vulnerability exists in Netpbm versions before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 in the jbigtopnm component. This flaw causes a heap buffer overflow when calculating the output buffer size for multi-plane JBIG files with large header dimensions. Exploitation can lead to application crashes or potentially arbitrary code execution.
